mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% annualized rate signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with triggered INDPRO and UNRATE conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in one month signals a monetary policy pivot, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS decrease > 50bps.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above $450 billion signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS above $450 billion.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%) signals a labor market overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with triggered PAYEMS and UNRATE conditions.
